messages:
anita: Quick heads-up: Kotlin SSE client failing when auth refresh happens mid-stream. Integration tests show partial JSON fragments dropped and parser throws. Repro+logs below.

oliver: Can you paste the minimal repro? Is this the same as the split-utf8 case or different?

anita: Different — it's a 401 refresh race. Flow: token expires -> server returns 401 on a keepalive ping -> client triggers token refresh and reconnect -> reconnect resumes with a chunk that completes a previously started JSON object, but our Kotlin incremental parser discarded buffer during reconnect.

mike: log snippet?

anita: Logs: 
```
[INFO] stream open
[DEBUG] recv: {"event":"partial","data":"{\"id\":1, \"txt\":\"Hel
[DEBUG] recv:  lo\"}\n"}
[WARN] got 401 on keepalive -> refresh
[INFO] reconnecting...
[ERROR] JSON parse error: Unexpected end of input
```

anita: Minimal repro is a test server that returns a partial object, then forces 401 during keepalive, then resumes sending the rest of the object on reconnect. Parser currently drops the partial buffer when we rebuild the socket.

sophia: What parser are you using? kotlinx.serialization JSON streaming? Or manual byte-decoder?

anita: We use a tiny hand-rolled incremental parser that expects a continuous stream; it resets state on reconnect. Maybe we should persist partial buffer across reconnects until we have a complete object.

harry: Two quick options: 1) keep a small tail buffer across reconnects and refeed into parser on resume; 2) use ndjson framing and only reset on newline boundary; 3) make token refresh non-destructive (pause parser while refresh).

oliver: Option 2 favored for reliability — server already sends \n terminator for objects? If so, keep last partial chunk in buffer until newline seen. Also add a metrics counter for 'discarded partials' so we catch regressions.

anita: Server is inconsistent for keepalive resends — sometimes no newline. Implementing 1 + metrics seems safest.

mike: I can do a small PR to the Kotlin client. Will add integration test that simulates 401 mid-chunk and ensures final assembled JSON is correct. @sophia can you review?

sophia: :thumbsup: add a unit test harness mimic for chunk boundaries. Also ensure retry backoff doesn't drop frames.

dev-bot: CI: build started for branch fix/kotlin-sse-buffered-reconnect (#3248)

mike: PR posted: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-kotlin/pull/78 — includes buffer retention + metric 'sse.partial_discarded' and test. Leaving notes in PR.

anita: Nice. One more: confirm auth flow doesn't double-insert Authorization header after refresh. I saw a duplicate header once.

mike: I'll check. If found, will patch; probably from cloning okhttp request without removing old header.

harry: If you need a quick pairing sesh, I have 30m free at 3:30pm. Otherwise we can land and watch the metric.

sophia: I'll review tonight. Good call to add test.

anita: Thanks all. Filing a tiny follow-up ticket to track metrics and backfill other clients if needed. /remind me in 24h to verify metrics. :calendar:
